# -spills extracts each architecture's cubin from the fatbin and lists
# the local-memory accesses nvdisasm -g attributes to source lines.
[!exec:sh] skip
chmod 0755 nvcc cuobjdump nvdisasm

exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -cuobjdump $WORK/cuobjdump -nvdisasm $WORK/nvdisasm -spills k.cu
stdout '^  local sm_90a _Z1kPf: 5 accesses, 3 inside loops$'
stdout '^    k.cu:8 spill, loop depth 2: 1 STL, 0 LDL \(first at 0x0030\)$'
stdout '^    k.cu:11 spill, outside loops: 0 STL, 1 LDL'
! stdout FAIL
exec cat args
stdout ' -lineinfo '
exec cat nvdisasm.args
stdout '^-g -c k.sm_90a.cubin$'

# Without -spills there is no line info and no disassembly.
rm nvdisasm.args
exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -cuobjdump $WORK/cuobjdump -nvdisasm $WORK/nvdisasm k.cu
! stdout local
exec cat args
! stdout lineinfo
! exists nvdisasm.args

# The gate fails only on a spill inside a loop.
! exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -cuobjdump $WORK/cuobjdump -nvdisasm $WORK/nvdisasm -no-loop-spill k.cu
stdout 'FAIL: sm_90a _Z1kPf: spill inside a loop at 0x0020 \(k.cu:6\)'
! exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -cuobjdump $WORK/cuobjdump -nvdisasm $WORK/nvdisasm -no-loop-spill -json k.cu
stdout '"Local":'
stdout '"loops": 2'

# A missing disassembler is named.
! exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -cuobjdump $WORK/cuobjdump -nvdisasm $WORK/none -spills k.cu
stderr 'nvdisasm: exit status 127 \(.*/none not found on the compiling host; -nvdisasm gives its path\)'

-- k.cu --
__global__ void k(float* x) {}
-- nvcc --
#!/bin/sh
echo "$@" > $WORK/args
out=
prev=
for a in "$@"; do
	[ "$prev" = -o ] && out=$a
	prev=$a
done
: > "$out"
cat >&2 <<'X'
ptxas info    : Compiling entry function '_Z1kPf' for 'sm_90a'
ptxas info    : Function properties for _Z1kPf
    40 bytes stack frame, 8 bytes spill stores, 8 bytes spill loads
ptxas info    : Used 32 registers, used 0 barriers
X
-- cuobjdump --
#!/bin/sh
[ "$1" = -xelf ] || exit 1
[ -e out.fatbin ] || exit 1
: > k.sm_90a.cubin
-- nvdisasm --
#!/bin/sh
echo "$@" > $WORK/nvdisasm.args
cat $WORK/listing.txt
-- listing.txt --
	.target	sm_90a
	.section	.text._Z1kPf,"ax",@progbits
        .global         _Z1kPf
        .type           _Z1kPf,@function
        .size           _Z1kPf,(.L_x_9 - _Z1kPf)
_Z1kPf:
.text._Z1kPf:
	//## File "/src/k.cu", line 3
        /*0000*/                   STL [R1+0x1c], R4                                 (*"SpillRefill"*);
        /*0010*/              @!P0 BRA `(.L_x_0) ;
.L_x_1:
	//## File "/src/k.cu", line 6
        /*0020*/                   LDL.LU R21, [R1+0x1c]                             (*"SpillRefill"*);
.L_x_2:
	//## File "/src/k.cu", line 8
        /*0030*/                   STL [R1+0x20], R5                                 (*"SpillRefill"*);
        /*0040*/                   LDL R6, [R1+0x40] ;
        /*0050*/              @P1 BRA `(.L_x_2) ;
	//## File "/src/k.cu", line 6
        /*0060*/              @P2 BRA `(.L_x_1) ;
.L_x_0:
	//## File "/src/k.cu", line 11
        /*0070*/                   LDL.LU R25, [R1+0x20]                             (*"SpillRefill"*);
        /*0080*/                   EXIT ;
.L_x_3:
        /*0090*/                   BRA `(.L_x_3);
.L_x_9:
